changelog:
Expanded to support both KylinOS V11 (Wayland/wlcctrl) and V10SP1 (X11/xdotool):

- Added OS detection script; backend is auto-selected for each platform.
- Separated fast-path usage and command examples for V11 and V10SP1.
- Introduced new scripts for X11 automation (click, drag, double-click, info).
- Clarified coordinate calculations for both Wayland (scale-aware) and X11 (pixel).
- Documented platform-specific command details, limitations, and required tools.
summary: GUI automation on KylinOS. V11 (Wayland/wlcom) uses wlcctrl; V10SP1 (X11) uses xdotool. Find/launch/focus windows, screenshot, click/type/drag with correct coordinates, and verify GUI results.
